# vastdata_kerberos_keytab (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vastdata_kerberos_keytab" "generate_keytab" {
  kerberos_id    = 1
  admin_username = "admin@EXAMPLE.COM"
  admin_password = "admin_password"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `admin_password` (String)
- `admin_username` (String)
- `kerberos_id` (Number) ID of the Kerberos configuration

### Optional

- `filename` (String) Custom filename for the keytab file
- `keytab_file` (String) Keytab file content

### Read-Only

- `service_principals` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service_principals))

<a id="nestedatt--service_principals"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service_principals`

Read-Only:

- `message` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `status` (String)
